text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The seasons have changed once again.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Exactly, City. Then, my trainer—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Slide!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text: Jordan! Come here a sec! There's something I wanna show you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoa, whoa… What's going on? You're seriously rushing me.

text_block_list.name: Gyarus B and C
text_block_list.text: Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Oh! They're on the racetrack…

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text: Yeah! They're joining the next tryouts! Both of them are totes fired up! They say they're definitely gonna get trainers!

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text: My debut race got decided too! So, like…

text_block_list.name: Gyaru A
text_block_list.text: Teach me how to run, Jordan! I wanna win races just like you!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Totally—like I would say no!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan has managed to leave a wonderful mark these last three years. Thanks to that, next year is also looking—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock… Slide.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Thank you as always for all your hard work, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The woman at the door is Tosen Jordan's homeroom teacher. We've had the chance to speak each time Jordan's needed extra classes or a makeup exam.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Well, it's been a breeze for me compared to you. Anyway, I was wondering… Is Jordan planning to race next year as well?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Ah… Good, I'm glad to hear it.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Then I'll be able to keep track of her on TV, even though she won't be my student anymore.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Run like the wind! Wahey!

text_block_list.name: Gyarus
text_block_list.text: Wahey!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Haha… You're lagging behind! Palmer is straight savage, so you're not gonna be able to catch her!
choice_data_list: Teaching your friends how to run?
Teaching your friends how to run?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Meh, something like that! They said they're all doing tryouts soon! So we're getting help from Palmer and City too…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: By the way, what's my homeroom teacher doing behind you? That's hilarious—since when did you two become friends?
choice_data_list: Since you had to do all those extra classes.
Since you had to do all those extra classes.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah… Hahaha… Well, thanks for scheduling all those.
choice_data_list: So, I have something to talk to you about.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You want to let her see me run? Why?
choice_data_list: She said she's leaving the academy.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: That's right. You see, I'm getting married. My fiancé and I are moving back to my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: That's why I want to see for myself how far my class's number one pain in the neck has come.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, are you allowed to say that to your students?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Meh, whatever. I'll do it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan and her friends all line up on the track.

text_block_list.name: Jordan and Friends
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They all take off at the same time. Mejiro Palmer manages to snag the lead, with Daitaku Helios right on her tail.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tosen Jordan is in the middle of the pack. She and Gold City are waiting for their chance…

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: GRRRAAAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And for some reason, Gold Ship appears behind them.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: …You know, I could never get her to stay awake in class. But look how happy she looks when she's running.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, wasn't there a time I flew into your office right after New Year's break to talk about it?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: She was such a handful—I was genuinely concerned. But ever since you became her trainer…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm not gonna loooose!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: I feel like she's changed. No, it's like she's become the real Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: So… thank you.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Uuugh… I'm running on fumes…

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Jordan. Keep up the good work.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Um, sure thing…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You too. Thanks for everything.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Sigh… So she's really leaving, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So I joined my friends for practice today, right? 'Cause they have tryouts soon.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: One year, three years… Time seriously flies by in the blink of an eye. I mean, I always thought tomorrow would just be the same as today.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: But, like… so much has changed.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Hey… Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I wanna win more and more races, and not just normal ones—GOAT level G1 races too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I wanna make it big! So… until the time comes when we have to go our separate ways…

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: All the way until then… I want you to be my trainer.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ahaha… Sounds good.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I'm counting on you!
